title: Implementer / fixer seat output (Codex backend)
description: The final message of a Codex writer seat (implement batch or fix round). sf-codex renders it to implement-<batch>.md / fix-r<N>.md and VERIFIES the reported commits against the worktree (a reported sha not in --baseline..HEAD fails the seat). plan_gaps is the measure of how well-bounded the plan was: semantic gaps are decisions that changed behaviour or an interface. NOTE: OpenAI strict structured outputs require EVERY declared property to be listed in `required` — optional fields are expressed as nullable types, never by omission from `required` (first live run: the API rejected the schema and the implementer seat failed).

task_id.description: The task id from the tasks block, or null when the commit spans none (fix rounds).

how.description: The exact command or check, and its outcome — never 'verified'.

what.description: What the plan did not specify.

decision.description: What you did and why it is the simplest interpretation.

declined.description: Fix seats only: findings declined with evidence. Empty for implement batches.

verify_first.description: Fix seats: one row per probe the FIX DIRECTION's verify_first lines asked for, run BEFORE editing. Empty for implement batches and for directions that asked for none.

id.description: The finding id the probe belongs to.

probe.description: The exact command or check you ran.

outcome.description: What it showed — numbers and paths, never 'verified'.

contradicts_approach.description: true when the outcome invalidated the direction's approach; that finding is then reported under blockers, not improvised.
